screening_decisions.reason: Double-blind randomized trial of aminophylline (theophylline analogue) versus placebo in patients with acute ischemic stroke; intervention administered during the acute hospitalization (consistent with within 1 week of onset).
Double-blind randomized trial comparing intravenous aminophylline with placebo in acute cerebral infarction; treatment given acutely (immediate post-injection effects), consistent with within 1 week.
Open-label, single-arm dose-escalation study of caffeinol; not randomized and no placebo/control, despite acute timing.
Physiologic/metabolic study; population not described as confirmed/presumed acute ischemic stroke and randomization/control not established.
Randomized cross-over physiologic study of dietary caffeine in patients recovering from acute ischemic stroke; not an acute (within 1 week) treatment trial versus placebo.
Randomized cross-over physiologic study of dietary caffeine in recovering stroke patients; not an acute (within 1 week) randomized treatment trial.
Non-randomized physiologic infusion study without placebo/control; stroke diagnosis/timing not aligned with acute ischemic stroke treatment within 1 week.
Animal study in cats; not a randomized human trial in acute ischemic stroke.
Animal study in dogs; not a randomized human trial in acute ischemic stroke.
Mechanistic/overview of aminophylline in cerebral vascular disorders; does not report a randomized placebo-controlled trial in acute ischemic stroke.
